name: Equinox 2-Person Full-Spectrum Infrared Sauna
pros: Plugs into a dedicated 120V circuit, no 240V electrician job
Published EMF figure (0.3 to 0.9 mG at 3 ft)
Hottest infrared cabin in this list at 165°F
cons: Needs its own 20A circuit with a NEMA 5-20 outlet
541 lb, so plan the delivery path
Price checked during a Black Friday sale; list price is $6,799

name: Sanctuary 2 Full-Spectrum Infrared Sauna
pros: Limited lifetime warranty, the longest in this list
Under-floor foot heater and app control included
Choice of basswood or mahogany
cons: Most expensive two-person pick here
Price shown is basswood on Black Friday sale; mahogany is $7,699
Red light therapy is a $1,399 add-on

name: Barcelona 1-2 Person Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna (DYN-6106-01)
pros: About a third of the price of the premium picks
Runs on a standard 15A household outlet
Two adults can assemble it in about an hour
cons: Tight for two adults (36 in wide inside)
Far infrared only, max 140°F
EMF quoted at 6 to 10 mG near the panels, higher than premium brands

name: Watoga 4-Person Barrel Sauna (6 ft x 5 ft)

specs.Warranty: Lifetime on room; heater 1 yr elements, 5 yr parts

pros: Real traditional heat with steam from the stones
Seats up to four
Rated for indoor or outdoor use
cons: Needs an electrician for a 240V, 30A circuit
Retailer adds $699 shipping; ships in about 4 to 5 weeks
DIY assembly of a barrel kit takes a weekend, not an hour
Barrel owners often add a roof or cover to stop rain leaks

name: Cold Tub + Chiller Bundle
pros: Chills and heats, so it doubles as a hot soak
Chillers are cETLus, cTUVus or CE certified
Modular: tubs and chillers sold separately or bundled
cons: Only a 1-year warranty
Separate chiller takes extra floor space
Exact bundle price varies by tub; confirm before buying

name: All-In Gen 2
pros: Chiller built into the tub, one clean footprint
App control and maintenance reminders
Full-length reclined position
cons: Price checked on a Black Friday sale; list is $9,990
Heating is a $500 add-on
Long footprint at about 77 x 32 in

name: Ice Barrel 300
pros: Cheapest real tub here, made in the USA
R16 insulation holds cold longer than inflatables
Small upright footprint
cons: No chiller, so you buy and haul ice
Upright position, not full-body reclined
About 700 lb when filled
